hypothesis: Reuse each local BF16 weight vector load across two independent token accumulators; identical per-token MAC/reduction order. No DMA/worker/FIFO changes.
validation: BF16 and W8A16 stages passed bitwise intermediates/output/shift, FP64 oracle, reset/branch, guards and immutable input checks. BF16 full-model 1533 vectors bitwise.
